Alright, Recruit. It'll be just like the debrief. We need to clear out the enemy horde and find the one leading them.
So far, so good. Keep it up.
Commander, we have a visual of a mutated zombie heading towards you.
We're on it now. Thanks, V.
Even after all these years, I'm still surprised by how many mutations there are. Some of them are almost completely invisible. They'll be showing up soon.
That's how a lot of our cities were destroyed. Make sure nothing can get by us.
The hordes nearby finally found you. They're starting to surround the area.
Necromancer spotted! Take it out before it can summon more skeletons!
I'm contacting HQ about sending more military into this area. Any nearby survivor camps won't stand a chance against this many zombies.
We're getting into the thick of it now. Hold your ground!
A group of Bosses are heading in.
You're drawing every zombie in a mile radius.
We've sent rescue units to find any remaining survivors now that they're distracted, but there are some encampments that are fighting the rescue. Aren't they worried about dying out here?
We're almost done clearing out the remaining camps. Those who decided to stay behind were given supplies. That's all we can do for now.
That's plenty, until the military clears out what's left before the next horde migration.
Commander, the leader of the horde is almost at your location.
You heard her. Set up our final defenses! We're getting out of this!
There it is! Fire everything we have and take out the Grave Digger!

We'll need a lot of firepower to take it down!
